clusters.name: types-and-config
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pure additive type/config scaffolding. No runtime emission, no UI. Must land before downstream stories because scoreRecommendations consumes the config shape and PipelineOverview consumes the new types.

clusters.name: derive-modules
clusters.executionModeRationale: Both modules are pure and live in their own files. They can be implemented in parallel by two agents without conflict, and only the emission story needs both.

clusters.name: sync-integration
clusters.executionModeRationale: Both stories edit the same file (sync-core.mjs) — state enrichment, incremental derivation propagation, and emitDerivedArtifacts wiring all modify the bundle-pass / merge path / writeSidecar. Must run serially within this cluster, with US-005 before US-006, because state.runDurations and the prdsByTaskId carrier must exist before writeSidecar serializes the sidecar and before emission writes derived artifacts. Plus the risky module is also being edited by the parallel Plan 05 crew member, so this cluster's branch will need a careful rebase before merge.

clusters.name: ui-integration
clusters.executionModeRationale: Story 7 (component + CSS) is independent of Story 8 (App.tsx wiring). Story 8 imports Story 7's component, so the two are sequenced within the cluster, but the cluster overall can start in parallel with sync-integration as long as types-and-config has merged first.

clusters.name: tests-and-plan-refresh
clusters.executionModeRationale: Final story validates the full feature end-to-end and cascades plan refreshes. Plan-refresh edits could conflict with Plan 05's plan edits if Plan 05 lands first — story instructions include a rebase check.
